# Apartment List

> > Apartment List is a pay-per-lease rental marketplace connecting renters with properties across major metros including Chicago, Tampa, Milwaukee, and California markets, powered by GenAI technology.

Apartment List serves both renters searching for apartments and property managers looking to fill vacancies. The platform offers rental management tools, market insights across major U.S. metros, and landlord resources covering Fair Housing Act compliance, lease-up marketing, and tenant screening best practices.

## Key Topics

- Pay-per-lease platform
- Rental marketplace
- Property management
- Multifamily leasing
- GenAI leasing technology (Lea Pro)
- Fair Housing Act compliance
- Lease-up marketing
- Rental market insights
- Metro analysis (Chicago, Tampa, Milwaukee, Orlando, Detroit)
- Landlord responsibilities
- Tenant screening
- First-time landlord guidance
- Rental laws and compliance
- Brand advocacy and renewals

## Landlord & Property Management Guides

- [First-Time Landlord Tips: Guide + Checklist](https://www.apartmentlist.com/rental-management/first-time-landlord-tips): Comprehensive guide for first-time landlords covering Fair Housing Act compliance

- [The Lease Signing Process for Landlords and Tenants](https://www.apartmentlist.com/rental-management/lease-signing-process): Step-by-step guide to lease signing process and state rental law compliance
- [How to Write An Eviction Letter (Free Template)](https://www.apartmentlist.com/rental-management/eviction-notice-letter-template): Free eviction letter template with guide for landlords removing tenants
